title: CPT Stage
description: One additive stage in the Kael/GAD continual pretraining (CPT) chain. Each stage expands the model's latent space by a small, curated token batch, then eval-gates before merging into the cumulative CPT adapter. Distinct from SFT/DPO/skill-adapter passes — those operate ON TOP of the CPT'd base.

stage_id.description: Stable slug for this stage. Convention: '<soul>-<lane>-cpt-v<major>.<minor>'. Example: 'kael-7b-cpt-v3.2'.

parent_stage_id.description: stage_id of the immediately prior CPT stage this builds on. Null for the first stage in a chain (base model only).

soul_id.description: Soul persona driving this model lane. Example: 'kael', 'gilgamesh', 'dr-stein'.

base_model_id.description: HuggingFace model ID or internal slug for the foundation base. Example: 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct'.

current_lane.description: Parameter class of this training lane. Promotion to a larger lane requires explicit operator sign-off per the scaling-up rule.

cumulative_adapter_path.description: Path to the LoRA adapter weights that accumulate all prior promoted CPT stages. Null if no prior stages have been promoted (first stage trains from raw base).

expansion_dataset_block_id.description: dataset_id from dataset_block.schema.json that supplies the expansion tokens for this stage. Must be promotion_status='promoted' or 'candidate' (candidate requires explicit authorization).

expansion_token_count.description: Target token count consumed in this stage's CPT run. Should be small relative to the base model's pretraining budget. First stages: 1-5M. Mid stages: 5-20M. Big-base (rare): 50-200M.

expansion_token_budget_max.description: Hard ceiling — refuse to start the run if expansion_token_count exceeds this value. Acts as a cost circuit-breaker. Operator sets this at authorization time.

mode.description: 'lora_cpt' = LoRA-rank CPT (default, cheap, reversible). 'full_cpt' = full-param pretraining (expensive, only for big-base runs). 'adapter_merge' = merge a previously trained adapter into the base without new gradient updates.

lr.description: Peak learning rate. Default: 2e-5 for lora_cpt. Reduce by 5x for full_cpt to avoid overshooting.

gradient_accumulation.description: Gradient accumulation steps. Effective batch = batch_size * gradient_accumulation * n_gpus.

sequence_length.description: Max token sequence length. Match to the base model's native context window or smaller. 8192 is the recommended default for 7B lora_cpt.

epochs.description: Number of passes over the expansion dataset. 1-2 for lora_cpt to avoid memorization. Never exceed 3 without a rebaseline.

lora_rank.description: LoRA rank r. Defaults: 16 for 7B, 32 for 14B+. Higher ranks capture more signal but increase merge cost.

lora_alpha.description: LoRA scaling factor alpha. Set equal to lora_rank as a safe default.

lora_dropout.description: Dropout applied to LoRA layers. 0.05 is a safe default for CPT. Higher values regularize stronger but slow convergence.

warmup_steps.description: Linear warmup steps. Default: 5% of total steps.

scheduler.description: LR scheduler. 'cosine' is the default for CPT stages.

bf16.description: Use BF16 mixed precision. Required for Qwen2.5 / Qwen3 on A100/H100.

regression_thresholds.description: Per-retain-bank maximum allowed score drop (in percentage points). If any bank drops more than its threshold, the stage is flagged as 'regressed'. Example: { 'hard-fn-norm-v1': 1.0 } means tolerate at most 1pp drop.

promotion_thresholds.description: Per-eval minimum required lift (in percentage points or absolute score points). Stage must lift on at least one promotion eval to be considered for merge. Example: { 'gad_tools_v1': 2.0 }.

cost_per_success_target_usd.description: Optional cost-efficiency gate. If the stage cost exceeds this value without a clear eval lift, halt the chain and reanalyze. Null = no cost gate (set for early exploratory stages).

hard_floor.description: Absolute minimum scores that must NEVER drop below threshold, regardless of regression_threshold. Breaching the hard floor triggers immediate abort + revert without waiting for human review. Example: { 'humaneval_clean_v1': 80.0 }.

retain_banks_enforced.description: retain_bank_ids (from retain_bank.schema.json) that must pass the regression_thresholds check. Stages may only promote if all banks listed here hold.

expected_outcome.description: Plain-English description of what this stage is expected to accomplish. Written before the run; compared against result after. Example: 'Improve gad CLI command recognition from gad-trace corpus; no regression on code-completion tasks.'

runtime.description: Compute backend. 'modal' is the default for CPT stages (A100/H100, pay-per-second).

authorization_required.description: True if this stage requires explicit operator green-light before running. Rule: stages with est_cost_usd > 20 MUST be true. Stages <= $20 may auto-fire when parent stage status=succeeded.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Transitions: planned → authorized → running → succeeded|regressed|failed → promoted|reverted. A 'succeeded' stage is not yet merged; 'promoted' means adapter merged into cumulative chain.

result.description: Populated after the run completes (status != planned|authorized|running). Null otherwise.

actual_tokens_consumed.description: Real token count processed during the run.

eval_results.description: Map of eval_id → score. Must include all evals referenced in eval_gates.

regression_check_passed.description: True if all retain banks stayed within regression_thresholds.

promotion_check_passed.description: True if at least one promotion_threshold eval lifted by the required amount.

adapter_path.description: Filesystem or object-storage path to the LoRA adapter produced by this run. Null if the run failed before checkpoint.

weights_hash.description: SHA-256 of the adapter weights tarball. Used for reproducibility audit.

decision_after_run.description: Human or automated decision on what to do with the result. Null until status=succeeded|regressed|failed.

decision.description: 'promote' = merge adapter into cumulative chain and bump version. 'revert' = discard adapter, stay on parent. 'hold' = awaiting more data before deciding. 'reauthorize' = re-run with adjusted budget/recipe.

decided_by.description: Agent ID or 'operator' or 'auto' (auto-promote fires when both regression+promotion checks pass and cost < threshold).

examples.expected_outcome: Expand gad CLI command recognition patterns from the most recent 60 days of gad-trace envelopes. Expect gad_tools_v1 to lift 2-4pp; no regression on code-completion retain banks.
Encode tool_call/tool_result JSON patterns from gad-log curator output. Reduce schema-validation errors on tool invocations by at least 3pp on the tool_action eval.

decision_after_run.rationale: Both regression and promotion gates cleared. tool-action-v1 lifted 3.8pp. Cost $2.35 under $4 target. Auto-promote eligible.
